paper_metadata.title: A Review of Constitutive Models and Thermal Properties for Nickel-Based Superalloys Across Machining-Specific Regimes
paper_metadata.journal: Journal of Manufacturing Science and Engineering

evidence.section: Abstract
evidence.quote: Nickel-based superalloys (Ni-alloys) are widely used in flight critical aeroengine components because of their excellent material properties at high temperatures such as yield strength, ductility, and creep resistance.

evidence.section: 6 Conclusion
evidence.quote: This review provides a summary of advances in the constitutive modeling and physical properties of Ni-alloys used in turbine applications, with a focus on machining-speciﬁc thermomechanical regimes.
